item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate this hypothesis if independently recomputed fish-caught-per-hour rates do not differ meaningfully between groups using live bait and groups not using live bait, after accounting for camper status, group composition, and hours.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Independently calculate fish_caught divided by hours for each visit, then compare adjusted rates across livebait groups while holding camper, persons, and child composition fixed.","mechanism":"Live bait increases fishing effectiveness, producing a higher fish-caught-per-hour rate.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_positive","predictions":[{"direction":"higher","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait-group rate is not higher than the non-livebait-group rate.","observable":"Adjusted mean fish caught per hour for visits using live bait versus visits not using live bait.","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate this hypothesis if independently recomputed fish-caught-per-hour rates do differ systematically between groups using live bait and groups not using live bait, after accounting for camper status, group composition, and hours.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Independently calculate fish_caught divided by hours for each visit, then compare adjusted rates across livebait groups while holding camper, persons, and child composition fixed.","mechanism":"Live bait has no material effect on fishing effectiveness; apparent differences are explained by other measured factors or sampling variation.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_null","predictions":[{"direction":"similar","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait-group rate is materially higher or lower than the non-livebait-group rate.","observable":"Adjusted mean fish caught per hour for visits using live bait versus visits not using live bait.","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate this hypothesis if independently recomputed fish-caught-per-hour rates are lower for groups using live bait than for groups not using live bait, after accounting for camper status, group composition, and hours.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Independently calculate fish_caught divided by hours for each visit, then compare adjusted rates across livebait groups while holding camper, persons, and child composition fixed.","mechanism":"Live bait is associated with reduced fishing effectiveness, potentially because it is selected in less favorable fishing conditions.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_negative","predictions":[{"direction":"lower","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait-group rate is not lower than the non-livebait-group rate.","observable":"Adjusted mean fish caught per hour for visits using live bait versus visits not using live bait.","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"How many fish on average do visitors take per hour when fishing, and which measured factors influence the fish-caught-per-hour rate?"}
